newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Robusta seen struggling with NY gains.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Robusta seen struggling with NY gains.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE July robusta coffee is expected to have difficulty keeping pace with New York's gains in arabica coffee futures, analysts said on Monday.
"Coffee had a good day on Friday, but robustas were not as strong as arabicas," said Susan Rigg at Chart Analysis. She pegged stiff July robusta resistance at the March 18 high of $1,700.
July robusta was called to open $20 higher, mostly riding on New York's coat tails.
On Friday, CSCE coffee rose for the third consecutive day with May scoring a contract high early at 218.00 cents.

A trader noted on Friday how London failed to react to a strong advance in the New York market. "At one stage, New York was five to six cents higher, and London wasn't reacting. The origins were obviously keeping the market down," he said.
But some traders were still positive on fundamental news, including the main truck drivers' union in Colombia beginning a nationwide strike at midnight on Saturday.
